title: Rapid Quantum Network Simulation Design with a Path to Scalable Execution
problem: Quantum network simulation frameworks difficult to work with and performance-limited due to serial nature; SeQUeNCe scalability not proven.
motivation: Need user-friendly framework for rapid quantum network experiment design with path to scalable execution.
method: BISQIT: block-diagram framework modeling components and data flows; demonstrates migration path to SeQUeNCe; scalability analysis on Frontier.
key_novelty: Block-diagram-based design framework for quantum networks; practical migration to production simulator.
contributions: BISQIT block-diagram framework for quantum experiment design
